_about: Sandbox settings (D99), Project Zomboid style: how the generated world is stocked and how hard it is. Every spawner reads its numbers here. A preset fills them all; the player's own choices (user://sandbox.json: {"preset": "...", "overrides": {"key": value}}) and --sandbox=preset / --sb.key=value on the command line win over it. Multipliers: 1 is the game as designed; 0 turns a thing off.

loot.abundance.name: Loot
loot.abundance.about: How much is in drawers, cupboards, crates and stashes (× the items rolled).

caches.frequency.name: Outdoor crates
caches.frequency.about: How many places outdoors have a crate (× the chance per place).

bandits.frequency.name: Bandits
bandits.frequency.about: How often bandits turn up (× the chance, ÷ the quiet time between encounters). 0: none.

bandits.max_near.name: Bandits at once
bandits.max_near.about: No new bandits while this many are alive within 250 m.

parked.frequency.name: Parked cars
parked.frequency.about: How full car parks and kerbs are (× the chance a bay has a car: about a third of car-park bays, one kerb space in nine). 0: none.

wrecks.frequency.name: Abandoned cars
wrecks.frequency.about: How many abandoned cars stand around (× the chance per 48 m square).

wrecks.runners.name: Cars that still run
wrecks.runners.about: The share of abandoned cars that still run: engine, battery and four wheels good enough to drive away.

wrecks.condition.name: Car condition
wrecks.condition.about: How worn abandoned cars' parts are (× their condition; above 1 better, never above 100 %).

wrecks.picked_over.name: Parts already taken
wrecks.picked_over.about: How often scavengers took parts before you came (× the chance a part is missing).

scavenger.about: A kinder world: more to find, cars that run, fewer bandits.

apocalypse.about: Little left, a lot of trouble.

road_trip.about: Sightseeing: no bandits, plenty of cars to borrow.
